top_choice_rationale: P005 rewards the best mechanistically defined achievement on the slate: bifunctional molecules that form a ternary complex and bring a chosen protein to an E3 ligase, with cooperativity and ubiquitin transfer reproduced independently by many groups. Crews and Deshaies supplied the concept and first demonstrations, and Ciulli's VHL ligands and ternary-complex structures made it a general, structure-guided design rule. That keeps it one coherent achievement within three names. P006 is my close second, since cereblon and the glue arm have the longest patient record, but crediting Handa alongside the PROTAC concept risks presenting two discoveries as one. P001 is the safest mature alternative with the cleanest attribution, but I rank it below degraders because it is more a platform and medicine achievement.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; I am a Stockholm University colleague of Xiaodong Zou, which is not a conflict for any candidate on this slate, and I have no tie to Crews, Deshaies, Ciulli or Handa.
